home.title: Turn a photo into an adorable acrylic belly
home.sub: An acrylic figurine with your face and a soft belly that squishes right back. 11 cm, a built-in fridge magnet, the name printed on the figurine itself.
home.s1Body: The background disappears automatically — right in your browser, before anything reaches us.
home.s2Body: You see the figurine 1:1. We print exactly what you approve — no surprises.
home.s3Body: Production 2–4 business days, courier 1–2 days. 11 cm, acrylic, magnet included.
home.priceSub: Every figurine can be different — the discount counts the total.
home.q1A: A clear, front-facing face in good light. The system warns if the resolution is low — the decision stays yours.
home.q2A: Production 2–4 business days plus courier 1–2 days. You see the exact date window at checkout.
home.q3A: A personalized figurine (with a photo or a name) is made to order and excluded from the 14-day withdrawal right (art. 38(3)). In exchange: you approve the preview before production, and defects are fixed — a remake or a refund.
home.q4Q: I don’t have a photo right now — what then?
home.q4A: Order with "I’ll send the photo later". After purchase you get a link to your order page where one click adds the photo.
home.q5A: BLIK, Przelewy24 and card — payments go live with the merchant account; until then orders are test-mode.
home.photoFridgeAlt: A finished figurine held on a fridge by its magnet
home.photoTableAlt: The figurine on a table — you can see the acrylic thickness
home.heroCap: Robert · 11 cm · acrylic, soft belly, magnet on the back.
home.heroAlt: The lying acrylic figurine with a man’s face and a mug of beer, on a light worktop.
home.realSub: No renders. These are photos of the finished magnet — the one you take out of the parcel.
home.r1d: You send one photo, we draw the rest. The background stays behind.
home.r2d: A silicone cushion sits under the acrylic. Press it — it springs back.
home.r3d: A magnet across the whole back. Slammed doors do not faze it.
home.marquee: FRESH DROPS · VIRAL · 100% YOU · GIFT OF THE YEAR · SHIPS IN 48H · PACKED BY HAND
